scripts.check: oxfmt . --check && oxlint . && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.clean: rm -rf coverage playwright-report test-results artifacts packages/*/dist
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && docker build -f packages/browser-runner/Dockerfile -t gameqa-browser-runner:e2e . && GAMEQA_RUNNER_IMAGE=gameqa-browser-runner:e2e vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
